component.name: Glassgram
component.summary: Telegram client with a liquid glass interface

description.p: An unofficial desktop Telegram client written in Rust. The layout follows Telegram Desktop; panels, menus and the composer are drawn as translucent glass.
Неофіційний десктопний клієнт Telegram на Rust. Структура — як у Telegram Desktop, панелі, меню й поле вводу — напівпрозоре скло.
Glassgram is not affiliated with Telegram FZ-LLC.

The interface in every language Telegram Desktop offers, with proper plural forms; MTProto and SOCKS5 proxies switched without a restart; spring animations and chat content blurred under the glass; animated custom emoji in messages; message effects and view-once photos and videos; sending as a channel; name colours, profile colour and emoji status; voice transcription and AI summaries of long posts; translating whole chats; a music player with a queue; profile stories, albums and the archive; attachment menu bots and logging in to websites with Telegram; send when online; retracting votes and stopping polls; folders sent as zip archives; an unread badge on the taskbar or dock icon.

Search tabs (chats, channels, apps, posts, media), sticker sets and saved GIFs, checklists and poll results, administration (admin rights, bans, join requests, invite links), My Stars, custom emoji in messages, a video player with seeking, full screen and picture-in-picture that streams large videos, chat wallpapers and themes, username QR codes, notification sounds and ringtones, Reply and Mark as read in notifications, narrow and wide window modes, a formatting bar over selected text, clearer glass with a refracting rim, smaller binaries.

Chat list density, sensitive content filter, connected websites, auto-delete timers, data and storage with cache limits, emoji games, account self-destruct, an error log, media auto-download by chat type, chat reactions and anti-spam for admins, accessibility options (reduce transparency, increase contrast, reduce motion), glass context menus and tooltips, recent actions and author signatures in channels, shared folders by link.
Bugfix: pinned chats and folders open on click again instead of being dragged, and their context menus work. The Windows executable carries a manifest and full version information.

Security hardening: safe links, safe file names, asking before hidden links and received programs. Saved Messages by source, search filters by type and sender, days with media in the calendar, stories, gifts and personal channels in profiles, emoji suggestions, reporting messages, opening chats at the first unread message, a send queue without duplicates, a memory budget for pictures. Large internal refactor.

Mini apps, sponsored messages, notifications for chats, contacts, translation, jump to date, polls and quizzes, privacy exceptions, group and channel editing, birthdays, bot start links, similar channels.
Windows installer and Flatpak, PipeWire microphone, Lucide icons, localisation files.
